name: Super Ultrawide 32:9 Support
author: maximilianopalomeque
description: Super ultrawide support for Slay the Spire 2. The game handles 21:9 natively and caps there, so a 32:9 display plays on half its screen; this builds the canvas at the real ratio and makes the artwork, the rooms and the HUD follow. Inert at 21:9 and below. Purely visual: declares affects_gameplay=false, so other players do not need it.
